name: Pascal
introduce:
NV-XX90 帕斯卡
由黑曜石和Nvidia联合开发的中型机兵。知名电子元件厂商Nvidia的跨界力作，在维持一贯的潮流外形与强大性能外，还针对米赫玛地区的独特地形气候做了专项适配。相信在不久的将来，持续探索、不断超越的Nvidia会在更多的领域打响他们的名号，持续收获支持者们的认可。

20344.name: RTX Frame
20344.SpecificEffects: When there is a surplus of ST Power, for every <color=#F74848>50</color> surplus Power, DMG +<color=#F74848>3%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>

20343.name: DLSS
20343.SpecificEffects: Stationary Arm [Blaster]. Can execute <skill mainSkill=20342>[Shock Wave]</skill> with a single [Blaster]. Can execute <skill mainSkill=20343>[High Tide]</skill> with two [Blasters].

30068.name: Accumulator Mod
30068.SpecificEffects:
Before actively attacking, if distance moved is <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles or less, DMG +<color=#F74848>18%</color>;
At end of action, immediately gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect has a <color=#F74848>1</color>-turn trigger interval.

20342.name: MMA PTX
20342.SpecificEffects: Stationary Arm [Blaster]. Can execute <skill mainSkill=20342>[Shock Wave]</skill> with a single [Blaster]. Can execute <skill mainSkill=20343>[High Tide]</skill> with two [Blasters].

20341.name: Tensor Core
20341.SpecificEffects: At end of action, if no movement occurred during this action, randomly loads <color=#F74848>1</color> Ammo for <color=#F74848>1</color> non-exhausted weapon.
